tool.name: VehicleAnalysis
tool.summary:
Vehicle detection post-processing for semantic segmentation outputs (DeepLabV3 + PointRend, ResNet-101 backbone). Extracts vehicle pixels from a single-band classified raster, applies morphological filtering (Majority Filter), vectorizes to polygons, simplifies boundaries (POINT_REMOVE), computes geometry and Minimum Bounding Rectangle (MBR) attributes, enriches with nDSM height and thermal statistics, and classifies features as Vehicle or Rejected possible vehicle based on area and L/W ratio thresholds. Produces a single output shapefile with accepted and rejected features, optional centroid points, and a JSON run log.
Requires Spatial Analyst and 3D Analyst extensions.
PIPELINE (8 phases): Extract binary > Majority Filter > Vectorize > Simplify > Geometry and MBR > Enrichment (nDSM + Thermal) > Classification > Export.
INPUTS: Classified Raster (single-band, integer), Vehicle Class Value (from raster unique values), nDSM Raster (m), Thermal Raster (deg C, optional), Area of Interest (optional), Output CRS (optional).
OUTPUTS: vehicle_results.shp (single layer with Class + Reason fields), vehicle_points.shp (centroids, optional), vehicle_log.json.
FIELDS: VehicleID, Area_m2, Perim_m, MBR_W, MBR_L, MBR_Azim, LW_Ratio, Compact, MEAN_nDSM, MEAN_Therm (if thermal provided), Class, Reason.
Part of the PostProcessing Toolbox (modular architecture: PostProcessing.pyt + _postproc_common.py + _vehicle_core.py).
Developed by Nikolaos Koroniadis, MSc thesis, Geography and Applied Geoinformatics, University of the Aegean (https://geography.aegean.gr/geoinformatics/). Remote Sensing and GIS Research Group (https://rsgis.aegean.gr/).
tool.usage: Run from ArcGIS Pro Catalog: PostProcessing.pyt > Vehicle > 1. Vehicle Analysis. Select the classified raster, pick the vehicle class value from the dropdown, provide an nDSM raster, and choose an output folder. The tool creates a vehicles subfolder with results. Optionally provide thermal data, an AOI mask, and a different output coordinate system. Review the vehicle_log.json for full run parameters and statistics.

param.name: in_classified
param.dialogReference: Single-band classified raster with integer pixel values representing land cover classes. Each unique value is a different class. The tool extracts pixels matching the Vehicle Class Value parameter. Must have at least 2 unique class values.

param.name: vehicle_class
param.dialogReference: The pixel value in the classified raster that represents vehicles. When you select a classified raster, the unique class values found in the raster are listed as choices. Pick the value that corresponds to vehicles.

param.name: in_ndsm
param.dialogReference: Normalized Digital Surface Model, heights above ground in meters. Used for mean height per feature via Zonal Statistics. Typical: cars 1.2-2.0 m, SUVs 1.8-2.5 m, trucks 2.5-4.0 m.

param.name: in_thermal
param.dialogReference: Single-band thermal raster in degrees Celsius (Altum-PT LWIR). If provided, MEAN_Therm is computed per feature via Zonal Statistics. The CRS of the thermal raster is displayed during validation.

param.name: in_aoi
param.dialogReference: Polygon or raster mask to clip the study area. If not set, the intersection of classified and nDSM extents is used.

param.name: out_crs
param.dialogReference: Coordinate reference system for all output shapefiles. Select from the globe icon or type an EPSG code (e.g. 2100 for EGSA87 / Greek Grid). Default: same as the classified raster. The CRS is applied only at the export phase to avoid raster reprojection issues during processing.

param.name: cell_size_option
param.dialogReference: Cell size for raster processing. Classified raster cell size (default, recommended) preserves full detail (~4.5 cm for Altum-PT). Maximum of inputs uses the coarsest resolution. Custom allows a user-defined value in meters.

param.name: cell_size_custom
param.dialogReference: User-defined cell size in meters. Only active when Processing Cell Size is set to Custom.

param.name: min_area
param.dialogReference: Polygons smaller than this area (m2) are classified as Rejected possible vehicle with Reason = Area_below_min. Reference: motorcycle 1.5-2.5, compact car 5-7, sedan 7-9 m2. Default: 1.5.

param.name: max_area
param.dialogReference: Polygons larger than this area (m2) are classified as Rejected possible vehicle with Reason = Area_above_max. Reference: SUV 9-12, van 15-25, truck 25-40 m2. Default: 12.0.

param.name: min_lw_ratio
param.dialogReference: Minimum Length/Width ratio from Minimum Bounding Rectangle. Features below this are classified as Rejected possible vehicle with Reason = LW_below_min. Removes square false positives (rooftops ~1.0-1.3). Typical vehicles: motorcycle ~3.0, car 2.0-2.8, SUV 2.2-2.6. Set to 1.0 to disable. Default: 1.5.

param.name: majority_neighborhood
param.dialogReference: Neighborhood for Majority Filter. FOUR (default): 4-connected, gentle. EIGHT: 8-connected, stronger. Skip: no filter applied.

param.name: majority_passes
param.dialogReference: Number of Majority Filter iterations. Each pass erodes edges by ~1 pixel. 1 (default) = light, 2 = moderate, 3+ = aggressive (may erode motorcycles). Disabled when Skip is selected.

param.name: simplify_tol
param.dialogReference: Douglas-Peucker tolerance in meters. Smooths pixel-staircase boundaries. 0.05 = minimal, 0.10 = moderate (default), 0.25 = cartographic, 0.50+ = aggressive.

param.name: do_centroids
param.dialogReference: Creates vehicle_points.shp with one centroid per feature (all features: accepted and rejected). Attributes carried over. Useful for heatmaps, density analysis, web maps.

param.name: out_folder
param.dialogReference: Root folder for results. A vehicles subfolder is created. Outputs: vehicle_results.shp, vehicle_points.shp (optional), vehicle_log.json. Existing outputs are overwritten.
